evidence_paraphrase: The original Horizon offer names Viela Bio common shares and identifies Nasdaq symbol VIE. Section 6 reports that same security's Nasdaq trading history for fourth-quarter 2019 and all four quarters of 2020, followed by first-quarter 2021 through February 11. This historical trading disclosure covers the required 2020 lookback; later offer terms and prices are not feature inputs.
